line_items.reasoning: Guidance called for Q2 revenues down low single digits; while NIKE Direct declined 9% globally, North America grew 9% and wholesale grew 8% globally, suggesting overall revenue performance was better than the low-single-digit decline guided — though NIKE Direct did not return to growth as expected (which was already guided as not expected).

Guidance called for Q2 gross margins down ~300-375 bps including 175 bps of tariff headwind; North America gross margins declined only 330 bps despite a 520 bps tariff headwind, and the net tariff impact was reduced to ~120 bps, suggesting underlying margin performance came in better than the guided range.

Guidance called for Q2 SG&A up high single digits driven by demand creation acceleration; no explicit SG&A figure was reported in the current results to confirm a clear beat or miss, so this is treated as inline.

Guidance called for wholesale to return to modest growth and North America to lead recovery; wholesale grew 8% globally (North America wholesale up 24%) and Running grew 20%+ for a second consecutive quarter, clearly exceeding 'modest growth' expectations.
Guidance called for a low 20% tax rate for FY26; no specific Q2 tax rate was reported in the current results to indicate a deviation, so this is treated as inline.
